newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end with strong gains.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end with strong gains.

text.p: March 14 - U.S. stock index futures closed with strong gains and near the center of broad daily ranges. Weaker than expected U.S. economic data aided bonds and index futures as it tempered sentiment the Fed would quickly move to raise rates. Some also tied gains to a technical bounce after steep declines Thursday, which analysts said did not damage the long-term uptrend. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
